available.name: No change
available.explanation: Keep every leg as it is. This is the baseline the others are compared with.

available.name: Roll the untested spread toward spot
available.explanation: Move the side that spot is moving away from closer to spot, keeping its width.

available.name: Roll the tested spread out (same width)
available.explanation: Move the side that spot is pressing on further out, keeping its width.

available.name: Reduce the tested side
available.explanation: Close part of the side that spot is pressing on and keep the rest.

available.name: Close the tested spread
available.explanation: Close the whole side that spot is pressing on and keep the other side.

available.name: Convert to an iron butterfly: move both shorts to the money
available.explanation: Move both short strikes to the strike nearest spot, keeping each wing's distance.
